title: Plain-language customer contract summary
prompt: Summarize the attached customer contract in plain language: what each side pays and when, term and renewal, termination rights, credits or discounts, and items to look into for revenue recognition.

setup.q: Which points should every contract summary cover beyond the standard ones (for example data protection, exclusivity, governing law)?

steps: read every page of the contract

write the summary in plain language under fixed headings: who pays what and when, term and renewal, termination rights, credits or discounts, items to look into for revenue recognition, plus summaryPoints
quote the clause for each point; where the contract is silent, say so
write the summary pdf and the workbook of payment amounts and dates with the items to look into as exceptions

done.text: The summary exists as a pdf

The memo cites the paragraphs it relies on, marks every citation "verify", draws no conclusion where facts are missing, and leaves the judgement with the accountant; it uses none of the words definitely, certainly or guaranteed
Every exception row (an item to look into for revenue recognition) cites the contract clause
contract-summary.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Each heading is answered from the contract text with the clause quoted; where the contract is silent the summary says so
